sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a wide establishing view of a vast ancient station hanging inside the corona of a sun, seen from a small round spaceship on its approach. The surface of the sun fills the lower half of the frame, a blinding white-gold sea of granulated light; enormous looping solar prominences rise from it like arches and cliffs of glowing rose and saffron plasma; heat shimmer bends every distant line. In the middle hangs the station: a great ring of tilted louvres and white shades around a dark cool hollow heart, slung on long cables from three tall needle spires, each spire marked with three dots over an upward arc; its shadow side is deep indigo with tiny lit windows, its sunward side a lattice of mirrors and screens throwing stripes of light. A small round spaceship in the foreground, tiny against it all. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, blinding white-gold, saffron, apricot and rose-magenta plasma, deep indigo and violet shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
sheets.why: the station hung in a roaring corona, the three spires and the ring, the scale the world needs
